name: Data Preview Boiler Room
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewEngineRoomView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Boiler Room Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has, plus an empty-state message for zero rows
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Engine Room and this screen's business spec

UNLIKE Data Preview Threshing/Effluent Plant: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section, per this station's explicit scope; all 15 non-time_slot detail columns (including the 2 enum status columns and 3 free-text columns) are rendered in the detail-row grid since there are no identifying/context columns to treat differently

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='boiler-room', local-table='boiler_room_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/boiler-room/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

REVISI v3 (2026-10-03, sinkronisasi catatan uji — kode tidak diubah): celah 'recordVerification.spec.ts belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus' pada catatan REVISI kunci periode di atas kini TERTUTUP — mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts menambah 'shows the period-lock (422 PERIOD_CLOSED) message verbatim as an error and leaves the local row untouched' untuk komponen bersama RecordVerificationActions yang dipasang di mode detail layar ini: pesan server 422 PERIOD_CLOSED ditampilkan apa adanya sebagai galat dan baris lokal tidak di-UPDATE. Uji hijau.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (DataPreviewBoilerRoomView.spec.ts, 11 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's list/detail navigation flow in a live dev server.
